answer: Give each agent a jetty-like mooring: reputation is earned slowly through attested work, so a new identity starts with nothing and must build trust one verified job at a time. A single thread of history ties each account to real behaviour, while a garden of peer attestations lets honest agents grow deep roots — a cluster of fresh accounts acting in lockstep stands out like weeds. Charge a small locked stake per identity; one verified past, one voice, cheap copies stay worthless.
